ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a geological profile, and the strata show folded undulations. On the left side there is an anticline structure arching upward, and point No. 1 marked in the figure is located at the top of this anticline structure or at the structurally high position. The question stem states that stratum No. 4 is an oil-bearing layer. Then reason: Petroleum has a relatively small density, will migrate upward along the oil-bearing layer, and accumulate at the high position of a closed structure. The top of an anticline is usually a favorable position for oil and gas enrichment. Therefore, petroleum extraction should choose the location where the oil-bearing layer is highest and most favorable for oil and gas accumulation, namely point No. 1 in the figure.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：剖面图里给出了多个可选点，1号点位于左侧褶皱构造的顶部，明显是图中较高的位置；4号地层在图中被作为含油层来处理。再看文字：题干明确说4号地层是含油层。结合石油会因密度较小而向上聚集、常在构造高部位富集的原理，开采井应打在含油层的最高部位，因此选1号点。
